annotation_policy: Authored before running any configuration; the schema is frozen and not tuned on these cases. Exact source spans, one per occurrence. date: calendar dates, months, years, quarters, weekdays, and relative day/week/year expressions such as tomorrow or last year; exclude clock times, durations (3.5 days), and numeric scores. event: a named or scheduled occurrence (meeting, conference, workshop, launch, retreat, review, party); span is the noun phrase without determiners and without separate date or place words; a place or date inside a named event is part of that event. location: a named place, including venues and landmarks, as one contiguous span; exclude generic places such as the office. Other types follow the existing schema conventions (names without titles). Cases without timeline annotations are deliberate negatives.
